issues.description: The template's oracle method for Exercise 3 declares the parameter `combinations` as type `str`, but the problem statement and the solution implementation expect `combinations` to be a list of bit-strings (list[str]). This parameter-type mismatch in the template will confuse students about the expected input and can lead to incorrect implementations or type errors when they follow the exercise description.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template method signature to accept a list of strings (e.g. combinations: list[str]) to match the problem statement and the solution. Also ensure the template docstring and any type annotations consistently state that `combinations` is a list of bit-strings.

issues.description: The template implementation of GroverMultiQubitMultiSolutionsWithAuxiliaryQubit.oracle declares the parameter `combinations` as type `str`, while the problem statement and the solution implementation expect `combinations` to be a list of bit-strings (`list[str]`). This internal mismatch (template oracle vs. template grover_circuit and vs. solution) creates a mapping/confusion for students: the grover_circuit (and problem text) will pass a list of combinations, but the oracle signature in the template appears to accept a single string, which may lead to type confusion or runtime errors when students attempt to integrate components.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template oracle signature to accept `combinations: list[str]` (matching the problem statement and solution) and adjust any related docstrings/comments accordingly so students see a consistent parameter type for the multi-solution oracle.
